label: WhatsApp Receive (Baileys)
description: Fires on each incoming WhatsApp message that passes the filters, from a BaileyBridge's `bridge` (it follows the bridge's `message.received` events).

inputs.name: bridge
inputs.description: The `bridge` output of the BaileyBridge node to talk through.

inputs.name: ignoreGroups
inputs.label: Ignore group chats
inputs.description: Only fire on direct messages; group messages are dropped.

inputs.name: messageTypes
inputs.label: Only these message types
inputs.description: Only fire on these types: text, image, video, audio, document, sticker, contact, location, unknown. Empty: every type except unknown. Unlisted types are dropped. unknown is anything else (a reaction, a poll, a protocol message), has no content, and fires only when listed.

outputs.name: content
outputs.description: The message's text, or the caption of a picture, video or document. Absent for a voice note, for a picture, video or document sent without a caption, and for a sticker, contact, location or unknown message. FirstInOrder over a voice note's transcript and `content` picks whichever exists.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The stored media for image, video, audio, document and sticker messages; absent otherwise.

outputs.name: fileSize
outputs.description: Media size in bytes as WhatsApp reports it before download; absent for text. Gate on it to refuse oversized files.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: Length of a voice note or video in seconds; absent otherwise. Gate on it before paying to transcribe a long one.
